_doc: Lightmap bake settings per wing (design/godot-bake-quality.md). Read by tools/bake_quality.gd from
tools/build_mall.gd finish(). 'active' picks the profile; --bake-profile=<name> or MALL_BAKE_PROFILE overrides it.
Revert to the Demo 51 look: set 'active' to 'd51' (or build with --bake-profile=d51), rebuild, rebake.
texel = metres per lightmap texel (smaller = finer). Each mesh group's texel is texel x its rule's mult,
or the rule's absolute 'texel' (stand-in zones). floor_texel (when set) moves each own hall/court floor
into its own mesh '<zone>_fl' at that texel; null keeps the floor inside the zone mesh (Demo 51).
A profile may not be coarser or lower than 'd51' anywhere unless it says allow_lower: true (Steven's yes

nov4._why: R2 has no pack size limit: own halls, courts, fronts and rooms 0.16 -> 0.10 m, the walked-on hall and court floors 0.06 m, the other wing's halls and courts (stand-ins) 0.40 -> 0.16 m. The outside (wing 3) unchanged.

nov4_lite._why: fallback if the nov4 lightmaps cost too much memory on the iPhone (design/godot-bake-quality.md 'Risks'): still finer than Demo 51 everywhere, about half nov4's extra texels

wings._doc: Overrides on top of the active profile, by scene: 'wing3' covers both years, 'wing3_2026' only 2026.

wing3._why: the outside: not part of the floor problem; kept at Demo 51 so it needs no rebake

rules._why: arcade machines: mostly lit by their own glow; a coarse texel keeps the atlas small
workstream E's big rooms: plain lay-in ceilings
workstream E's big rooms: floors and walls a little coarser than the halls
the other wing's halls and courts (the stand-in), seen across the seam only
an own hall or court floor split out by floor_texel
